_doc: Ship gates for a video-route character (scripts/assets/cast_walk.py gate). Every gate must PASS. Thresholds are the frog-settler's accepted numbers (CURATION.md, 2026-09-25), not taste.
_seam: loop seam / ordinary frame step, per direction. The frog shipped 0.16-0.48.

colour._: share of a direction's opaque pixels (all 10 frames) in colours that are >= min_share of the direction and farther than far_rgb from every colour making up >= anchor_share of the s-idle. The frog measures 0.005 at worst, the shipped vine-ranger 0.009; the mycologist's cyan e-visor measured 0.030.

consistency: consistency.py <kind> --check exits 0 (silhouette spec in consistency-spec.json, 48 px pack)

verify.frames: every frame, job = its direction's idle: s/se face visible, e a profile, ne/n no face

judge: sprites.judge GATES (judge-sprite-mp4) on each direction's raw loop frames

style._: verify.py --style --kind against the frog, the pack's reference video-route character
